title: Console export routing and analytics cataloging for enterprise requests
creator: Marc Liu
description: Prepare a repeatable intake and routing framework for enterprise console/reporting requests focused on usage analytics, cost breakdowns, export formats, and custom dashboards. Aim: reduce time-to-triage for high-value customer asks, create a catalog of supported export types/APIs, define SLAs for bespoke dashboard work, and surface security/compliance gating for exports. Deliverables: intake checklist, prioritized backlog, export API contract, sample mappings for cost dimensions, and a lightweight admin UI for request owners.
comments: 2026-03-01 - Kickoff: Synced with SalesOps (Elena Ortiz) and Solutions Eng (Samir Patel). Agreed to scope initial pilot with three enterprise customers (FinMate, HealthGrid, ShopLayer). Action: PM to draft intake checklist and mapping template.
2026-03-04 - Draft intake checklist uploaded to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/PM/Console+Export+Intake+Checklist. Requested feedback from Privacy and Security (cc @Diane Munroe).

2026-03-06 - Security review: Diane flagged PI/PD export risk for free-text logs. Decision: Block CSV exports of raw logs until PII scrubber implemented. Added 'security_review_required' gating to intake flow.

2026-03-08 - Engineering scoping with runtime infra (ENG-4891). Estimated backend work to add export endpoints + job queue: 5 wks. See GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4123
2026-03-10 - Design pass: Elena shared mock for admin routing UI (Figma): https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/Console-Export-Routing. Feedback: include per-customer retention and masking toggles.

2026-03-11 - Prioritization review with GTM: Mapped requests to revenue (x3 customers ~ $150k ARR). Decision: pilot export API v1 for cost breakdown + token-level attribution, defer custom dashboards to Q3 unless customer funds.
2026-03-12 - Action items: 1) ENG to scope export API auth and throttling (ENG-4912), 2) PM to prepare PRD and pilot contract template, 3) Design to finalize admin UI mocks.
2026-03-12 - Blocking: Need legal sign-off on data-processing addendum for customers exporting usage-level data. Point person: Legal / Priya Rao.
notes: Pilot scope limited to: (1) cost-breakdown CSV with token attribution, (2) daily export job with retry/backoff, (3) admin UI route to map customer requested metrics to in-platform dimensions. Avoid one-off dashboard builds in pilot to validate API effectiveness.
